scripts.build: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/telemetry/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/probes/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/hostile-proxy/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/telemetry/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/probes/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/sdk/tsconfig.json --noEmit && node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc -p packages/hostile-proxy/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run packages/telemetry/src packages/probes/src packages/sdk/src packages/hostile-proxy/src
scripts.test:coverage: node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --coverage packages/telemetry/src packages/probes/src packages/sdk/src packages/hostile-proxy/src
